headline: Jingshui Fu rockets from 3,527th to 64th on ARC-3

sections.text: Jingshui Fu added 33.12 points to reach 33.22, vaulting from 3,527th to 64th in the past day. The move carries Fu into the top 100 on a board with 4,175 teams.
That is a striking climb through a crowded field, although the standings remain a public snapshot rather than a medal result. ARC-3 medals will be decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
